subject.title: docs(onboarding): finalize phase status and phase 7 decision

question: Should the onboarding plan continue to recommend CLI-side auto-doctor for Phase 7 now, or should it present the alternatives neutrally until a designated owner approves the startup-policy direction?
rationale: This PR does not implement Phase 7, but its documentation can set the expected product direction for a security-sensitive startup-policy boundary; that choice cannot be inferred safely from the documentation diff alone.

options.title: Approve the decision memo
options.body: Keep the recommended CLI-side auto-doctor path and merge the clarified phase-status documentation after owner confirmation.

options.title: Keep Phase 7 neutral
options.body: Remove the recommendation and document both options as unresolved until an owner decision and security review are recorded.

recommendation.title: Approve the decision memo
recommendation.body: Keep the recommended CLI-side auto-doctor path and merge the clarified phase-status documentation after owner confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context identifies steipete as the author of the Phase 7 decision memo; a designated onboarding owner should confirm or supersede that proposal.
